meta.title: ReceptionAI: AI Receptionist for Nail Salons

scenes.goal: Owner feels the cost of missed calls
scenes.voiceover: Every missed call during peak hour is a booking walking out the door. Your hands are busy, and the phone keeps ringing.
scenes.visual: Busy salon counter; phone toast stacking unanswered
scenes.motion: Toasts stack with spring, counter ticks up on the word 'booking'

scenes.goal: Introduce ReceptionAI as the always-on receptionist
scenes.voiceover: Meet ReceptionAI. It answers every call, day or night, in a friendly voice. It knows your services, your prices and your opening hours.
scenes.visual: Phone toast flips to a green answered state; waveform pulses with the AI voice
scenes.motion: Card morphs from missed to answered; waveform driven by the voiceover

scenes.goal: Show the booking landing in the calendar with no staff effort
scenes.voiceover: Callers book, change or cancel appointments while you stay focused on the client in your chair. Every booking lands straight in your calendar.
scenes.visual: Calendar view; a new appointment block slides into an open slot
scenes.motion: Appointment block slides in with spring; confirmation tick draws on

scenes.goal: Close on the brand, tagline and call to action
scenes.voiceover: ReceptionAI. Never miss another salon appointment. Start your free trial today.
scenes.visual: Brand-colour background, logo and tagline centred, CTA button below
scenes.motion: Logo scales in, tagline fades up, CTA pulses once
